FUNCTION handleListSensors(request):
    // REQ-2-012; Preconditions: local persistence is available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin; otherwise RETURN 401.
    VALIDATE filters, limit, and after_id; RETURN 422 if invalid. IF supplied owner_id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    IF caller is user AND owner_id names another user THEN RETURN 403. END IF
    READ only caller-owned sensors for user, or filtered sensors for admin; order by id and page; RETURN 200.
    // Transaction: none. Postcondition and all error paths leave sensors, readings, policies, and alerts unchanged; RETURN 500 or 503 only for local failures.

FUNCTION handleCreateSensor(request):
    // REQ-2-013; Preconditions: JSON body and available persistence.
    REQUIRE authenticated admin or RETURN 401/403; REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415; parse JSON or RETURN 400.
    VALIDATE REQ-2-001; RETURN 422 if invalid. IF owner_id <= 0 OR owner absent THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    BEGIN TRANSACTION. IF serial exists THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    CREATE sensor; COMMIT; RETURN 201 with Location.
    // Non-idempotent. On every error rollback; sensor, readings, policy, and alerts remain unchanged.
